Efrin is one of  Auntie Ethel's victims. He is in a  petrified state in the Entrance Gallery of the Overgrown Tunnel near the Blinded Elf.
“
My dearest Efrin, he begged me to halt the deadly disease that ravaged him.
„
— Auntie Ethel about Efrin's fate

Involvement

Act One

A party member can interact with Efrin when he is petrified, or after  Auntie Ethel is killed. However, defeating Ethel without killing her - such as accepting  Auntie Ethel's Hair in exchange for her freedom - does not lift the curse. Using a  Basilisk Oil potion is needed to cure him of the status condition.

Before or without killing the Hag

When the party first meets Efrin, he is  petrified. Using a  Basilisk Oil potion at his feet cures him of the status condition and initiates a conversation with him. He reveals he has a disease called "The Bite" (also called Laduguer's Bite). Efrin yells at the party for 'saving' him while the disease is not cured and immediately dies.

Casting  Speak with Dead on Efrin after he dies provides more information about his life including his surname and family status.

After killing the Hag

After killing the hag, Efrin's curse is broken and his petrification ends. He begins a conversation with the party immediately, warning that he has a disease called "The Bite":

  • Efrin
    I was on death's door. But now I feel... I feel great. How?
    • [PALADIN OF ILLMATER] [CLERIC OF ILLMATER] Search for any sign of Laduguer's Bite.
    • [ARCANA] Look for remnants of the hag's magic. (DC 15)
    • [MEDICINE] Examine him for signs of Laduguer's Bite. (DC 15) (Non-duergar only)
    • [DUERGAR] [MEDICINE] Examine him for signs of Laduguer's Bite. (DC 10)
    • [BARD] In the tales, hags always cook up their victim's misery first, then sell them false hope.
    • [SORCERER] Attune with your blood and search him for magic.
    • [SORCERER] I can feel the hag's magic on you - it tastes of sickness.
    • [WIZARD] Mordenkainen warns us that hags often cause their victims' tragedies.
    • [WIZARD] Examine him for signs of magic.

Picking one of the above options reveals the curse was actually a magical infliction caused by the hag, that Efrin is free and does not actually have Laduguer's Bite. He curses the hag, swearing that he will repay the party for his freedom, and escapes from the tunnel.

Speak with Dead

Efrin's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Cured? Were you sick?
    • Efrin
      I'd the Bite... Laduguer's Bite... sickness worse than... death.
      • Efrin
        Hag turned me... to stone. Stopped the... spread.
  • What is your name?
    • Efrin
      Efrin... Hammerborn...
  • What happened to you?
    • Efrin
      Got sick... had to leave home... leave my children...
      • Efrin
        ... wonder what... they look like now...
  • What can you tell me about the hag?
    • Efrin
      She'll give you more... than you bargained... for...
